text:
In the night beside you
+
+words are codes, they are keys.
+
+the desire to die is king.
+
+
+May your body always be
+
+a beloved space of revelations.

translation.title: In the Night beside You…
translation.editorial_note: Claves and llaves become codes and keys to preserve their distinction; the lowercase enthronement of death remains inside an otherwise tender bodily revelation.
